title: Add greeting() to Greeter and call from Main
body:
Add a public method `greeting(String name)` on `Greeter` returning `"Hello, " + name + "!"`. Wire `Main.main` to call `greeting("world")` and print the result.

## Allowed files
- src/main/java/com/example/Greeter.java
- src/main/java/com/example/Main.java
